issue_request: FHIR-20196 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested expanding http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/capabilitystatement-expectation to an explicit list of CapabilityStatement elements, including format, patchFormat, implementationGuide, REST security, resource/profile/support details, interactions, operations, and search parameters.
initial_application: Core commit 5b129917061c5f19861dfc5326f95b4be59d507c applied FHIR-20196 together with FHIR-27829 by adding the requested explicit contexts to source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-extension-capabilitystatement-expectation.xml.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed the R5 extension definition from source/capabilitystatement when extension definitions moved out of core. Current source/fhir.ini has no active profile entry for capabilitystatement-expectation. The FHIR Extension Pack initial import preserved the FHIR-20196 context set, while later Published FHIR-extensions issue FHIR-46192 intentionally removed instantiates, rest.interaction.code, rest.interaction.documentation, and rest.resource.profile and added acceptLanguage and messaging contexts.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The current core checkout is not the authoritative source for this extension, and the current external source reflects later work-group intent for the context list.
